meta.title: Spiegel - Test a campaign before you spend the budget
meta.description: Spiegel - test a marketing campaign on simulated customers

home.heroDesc: {brand} turns your campaign brief and creative into {agentScale}, releases the campaign into a simulated social feed, and reports what happened — reach, engagement, sentiment, virality and objections — {optimalSolution}.
home.slogan: Test the campaign on simulated customers, not on your budget
home.heroSub: Upload your ideas, get the assessment.
home.systemReadyDesc: Engine on standby. Upload the campaign brief and creative to build your customers and run a test.
home.step04Desc: Actions become numbers and a report
home.projectsSub: Open a past test to read its report and ask follow-up questions, or start a new one.

step1.ontologyDesc: The LLM reads the campaign brief and your customer description, and generates the ontology used to structure the campaign knowledge graph
step1.graphRagDesc: The brief and creative are chunked and ingested into the campaign knowledge graph — products, messages, customer entities and the relations between them
step1.stopConfirm: Stop the build? Progress so far will be discarded and you will need to start it again.
step1.buildCompleteDesc: Campaign graph is built. Next: turn its entities into customer personas.
step1.sourceTextEmpty: No extracted text was stored for this project.
step1.sourceTextFailed: Could not load the extracted text.
step1.createSimulationFailedTitle: The simulation could not be created

step2.simInstanceDesc: Create a new campaign test and pull the simulated-feed parameter templates
step2.generateAgentPersonaDesc: Entities from the campaign graph become customer personas — demographics, needs, brand attitude, purchase behaviour and media habits
step2.dualPlatformConfigDesc: The LLM sets the feed's time flow, recommendation weighting, and each persona's active hours, posting frequency and trigger conditions
step2.commentsSeenPerPostHint: How many replies each persona reads under a post. Which ones they get is drawn at random, weighted by the reactions each reply has collected.
step2.initialActivationDesc: The campaign creative is turned into the opening posts and topics that seed the simulated feeds
step2.setupCompleteDesc: Customers and feeds are configured. You can now release the campaign.
step2.audienceSizeDesc: How many customers to model. Segments from the graph are cloned up to this number, or trimmed down to it. Capped at {max}.
step2.audienceSizeTip: A bigger audience costs no extra to build, but more customers active per hour means more tokens per round.
step2.roundsConfigDesc: Auto-planned to cover {hours} hours of campaign exposure, each round representing {minutesPerRound} minutes
step2.roundsTip: Simulations consume a lot of tokens. For a first run, keep this under 40 rounds.
step2.personaDimExperienceDesc: History with this product category and brand
step2.personaDimMemoryDesc: Prior impressions carried into the campaign
step2.personaDimSocialDesc: Where they spend attention and who they listen to

step3.startingDualSim: Releasing campaign into both simulated feeds...
step3.oldSimCleared: Old simulation logs cleared, restarting simulation
step3.preparingGoBack: Preparing to return to Step 2, closing simulation...
step3.closeFailed: Failed to close simulation environment, attempting force stop...
step3.startFailedBanner: The campaign could not be released: {error}
step3.reportFailedBanner: Report generation could not be started: {error}

feedBoard.author: Author
feedBoard.noPosts: No posts in this simulation yet
feedBoard.selectPrompt: Select a post to read it

step4.nextStepDesc: Put them to the customers themselves — any persona in this run can be asked to explain what they did and why.
step4.panelKeyFacts: Latest key facts from temporal memory

step5.reportAgentDesc: The conversational version of the agent that wrote the assessment, with 4 tools and full access to the campaign graph and the measured results
step5.toolInsightForgeDesc: Aligns real-world seed data with simulation state, combining Global/Local Memory for cross-temporal deep attribution analysis
step5.toolPanoramaSearchDesc: Graph-based BFS algorithm that reconstructs event propagation paths, capturing the full topology of information flow
step5.toolQuickSearchDesc: GraphRAG-based instant query interface with optimized indexing for fast extraction of node attributes and discrete facts
step5.toolInterviewSubAgentDesc: Autonomous interviews that conduct parallel multi-round dialogues with simulated individuals, collecting unstructured opinion data and psychological states
step5.chatEmptyReportAgent: Ask the Report Agent to dig into any part of the campaign assessment
step5.chatEmptyAgent: Interview customers to hear their objections in their own words
step5.surveyInputPlaceholder: Enter the question you want to ask all selected targets...
step5.profilesFailed: The audience list could not be loaded: {error}
